column8: As you defeat Alice, your body wrapped in white light.\nIn the next moment, you find yourself standing outside.\n<wait>

column8: Not feeling like leaving Shinagawa,\nyou decide to head back to Prince Hotel.\n<wait>

column8: Wait. I promised Doctor Hirasawa that I'd bring Alice back.\n<wait>

column6: すまん。{01:1C}も急いでるとは思うが、頼むよ。\n

column6: 高層ビル{08:74}が墓標の{08:69}に立ちつくす下{02:08}\n多くのビルが瓦礫と化し、道路はひび割れ、黒焦げの自動車で埋め尽く{03:0C}{08:14}。\n<wait>
column8:
What was once a prospering city is now but a gravesite of the old world.
Most of the buildings have crumpled down, and the streets are blocked by
piles of charred remains of cars and other junk.
<wait>
